description: Abstract base controller class for Thingsboard server, providing common exception handling, entity validation, permission checks, and utility methods for REST API controllers.

classes.name: BaseController
classes.description: Abstract class providing common REST API exception handling, entity validation, permission checks, and utility methods for Thingsboard server controllers.

methods.name: handleControllerException
methods.description: Handles generic exceptions, mapping them to ThingsboardException and delegating to errorResponseHandler.

methods.name: handleThingsboardException
methods.description: Handles ThingsboardException and delegates to errorResponseHandler.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Maps various exceptions to ThingsboardException with appropriate error codes.

methods.name: handleValidationError
methods.description: Handles validation errors for @Valid annotated method arguments.

methods.name: checkNotNull
methods.description: Utility to check for null references, throws ITEM_NOT_FOUND if null.

methods.name: checkParameter
methods.description: Validates that a string parameter is not blank.

methods.name: checkArrayParameter
methods.description: Validates that an array of strings is not null or empty.

methods.name: checkEnumParameter
methods.description: Converts string to enum value, throws BAD_REQUEST_PARAMS if invalid.

methods.name: toUUID
methods.description: Converts string to UUID, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: createPageLink
methods.description: Creates a PageLink with optional sorting.

methods.name: createTimePageLink
methods.description: Creates a TimePageLink with start and end times.

methods.name: checkTenantInfoId
methods.description: Validates tenant info ID and permissions.

methods.name: checkTenantProfileId
methods.description: Validates tenant profile ID and permissions.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns tenant ID of current user.

methods.name: checkEntityId
methods.description: Validates entity ID and retrieves entity with permission check.

methods.name: checkEntity
methods.description: Checks entity permission for existing entity.

methods.name: checkAlarmCommentId
methods.description: Validates alarm comment ID and matches alarm ID.

methods.name: checkComponentDescriptorByClazz
methods.description: Retrieves component descriptor by class name.

methods.name: checkComponentDescriptorsByType
methods.description: Retrieves component descriptors by type and rule chain type.

methods.name: checkComponentDescriptorsByTypes
methods.description: Retrieves component descriptors by multiple types.

methods.name: checkRuleNode
methods.description: Validates rule node ID and its rule chain.

methods.name: checkQueueId
methods.description: Validates queue ID and permission for tenant.

methods.name: emptyId
methods.description: Returns an empty entity ID for a given entity type.

methods.name: logEntityAction
methods.description: Logs entity actions with user and action details.

methods.name: checkUserInfo
methods.description: Checks and updates user additional info and credentials.

methods.name: checkDashboardInfo
methods.description: Validates dashboard info in additional info.

methods.name: extractHomeDashboardInfoFromAdditionalInfo
methods.description: Extracts home dashboard info from additional info JSON.

methods.name: parseMediaType
methods.description: Parses content type string into MediaType.

methods.name: createEntityDataSortOrder
methods.description: Creates entity data sort order based on property and direction.

methods.name: compressResponseWithGzipIFAccepted
methods.description: Compresses response with gzip if accepted.

methods.name: redirectTo
methods.description: Creates redirect ResponseEntity to a URI.

methods.name: getOAuth2ClientIds
methods.description: Validates and returns list of OAuth2 client IDs.
